Callout.Name: Electrical Fire at a Depot
Callout.Message: Fire in an electrical cabinet at a depot.
Callout.Advisory: Power isolated by staff, no injuries.

Script.Line: We killed the power at the main. Everybody is out and counted.
It is the cabinet by the loading bay. It has been arcing for a week.
Nobody goes near that bay. I have made sure of that.

Lines.Approach: They have killed the power, so it is smoke and burnt plastic rather than anything worse.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
